name: Madrasti MMS — School Management System
description: School-management application for student records, attendance, scheduling, administration, authentication, and role-based access. Includes Spring Boot APIs, PostgreSQL data modeling, validation, unit and integration testing, and Playwright end-to-end testing.

name: Scootry — Scooter Rental Platform
description: MERN scooter-rental platform with scooter discovery, availability, user accounts, reservations, secure authentication, interactive maps, and wallet-related workflows.

name: Fennec Go — Mobile Fintech Application
description: React Native mobile interfaces integrated with API-driven financial workflows and secure customer-facing experiences.
